name: Haus Arnold Schranz
beschreibung:
Sunnily situated on a quiet hillside in St. Anton am Arlberg, Haus Arnold Schranz offers well-kept guestrooms with delightful valley vistas. It makes an ideal haven for skiers and summer adventurers.

St. Anton cable cars and the village amenities are reached in minutes.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Arnold Schranz in St. Anton am Arlberg provides warm family hospitality and comfort on the Arlberg.
